about: Config changes made on purpose by a version (ADR-0047). CUMULATIVE: never remove an entry. kind: retire (key removed from config.json), rename (value moved to 'to'), set (new recommended 'value', operator accepts or keeps; 'default': accept|keep), choose ('options': [{value,label}], 'default': one option value). Applied once per install at start; set/choose wait for an operator decision (Updates panel / console Config > Update > C).

changes.reason: The bundled companion version is now read from the APK file itself
